text: ふふ　ふふふふ　ぼくの　おもった　とおり…　おまえの　あとを　つけてきて　せいかい　だった！

structure.jp: ぼくの　おもった　とおり…
おまえの　あとを　つけてきて

patterns.name: 〜とおり
patterns.span: ぼくの　おもった　とおり
patterns.explanation: とおり after a verb means 'exactly as'. The の after ぼく stands in for が here, so ぼく is the one who thought. ぼくの　おもった　とおり = 'just as I thought'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says the action was done all the way to here. つけてきて = 'followed you here'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つけてきて　せいかい　だった
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins the action to the judgement about it that follows. つけてきて　せいかい　だった = 'following you here was the right call'.
